006package gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.datatype.adapter;
007
008import com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.jsonFormatVisitors.JsonFormatTypes;
009
010import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.datatype.AbstractDataTypeAdapter;
011import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.item.atomic.IDayTimeDurationItem;
012import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.item.atomic.IDurationItem;
013import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.item.atomic.IYearMonthDurationItem;
014import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.type.AbstractAtomicOrUnionType;
015import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.util.ObjectUtils;
016
017import java.math.BigDecimal;
018import java.math.RoundingMode;
019import java.time.Duration;
020import java.time.Period;
021import java.util.regex.Matcher;
022import java.util.regex.Pattern;
023
024import edu.umd.cs.findbugs.annotations.NonNull;
025import edu.umd.cs.findbugs.annotations.Nullable;
026
027/**
028 * Supports working with duration-based data values.
029 *
030 * @param <TYPE>
031 *          the raw Java type this adapter supports
032 * @param <ITEM_TYPE>
033 *          the metapath item type supported by the adapter
034 */
035public abstract class AbstractDurationAdapter<TYPE, ITEM_TYPE extends IDurationItem>
036    extends AbstractDataTypeAdapter<TYPE, ITEM_TYPE> {
037  private static final Pattern DURATION_PATTERN = Pattern.compile(
038      "^(?<sign>-)?"
039          + "P"
040          + "(?:(?<year>[0-9]+)Y)?"
041          + "(?:(?<month>[0-9]+)M)?"
042          + "(?:(?<day>[0-9]+)D)?"
043          + "(?:T"
044          + "(?:(?<hour>[0-9]+)H)?"
045          + "(?:(?<minute>[0-9]+)M)?"
046          + "(?:(?<second2>[0-9]+(?:\\.[0-9]+)?)S)?"
047          + ")?$");
048
049  @NonNull
050  private static IDurationItem validate(
051      @NonNull String value,
052      @Nullable Period period,
053      @Nullable Duration duration) {
054
055    if (period != null && duration != null) {
056      throw new IllegalArgumentException(
057          String.format("Invalid year/month or day/time duration value '%s'.",
058              value));
059    }
060
061    IDurationItem retval;
062    if (period != null && duration == null) {
063      retval = IYearMonthDurationItem.valueOf(period);
064    } else if (period == null && duration != null) {
065      retval = IDayTimeDurationItem.valueOf(duration);
066    } else { // both are null or zero
067      retval = IDayTimeDurationItem.valueOf(ObjectUtils.notNull(Duration.ZERO));
068    }
069    return retval;
070  }
071
072  /**
073   * Parse a set of text tokens as a period value.
074   *
075   * @param negative
076   *          {@code true} if the period is negative or {@code false} otherwise
077   * @param yearsFragment
078   *          an integer value indicating the amount of years in the duration
079   * @param monthsFragment
080   *          an integer value indicating the amount of months in the duration
081   * @return a period based on the amount of years and months
082   */
083  @NonNull
084  protected static Period parsePeriod(
085      boolean negative,
086      @Nullable String yearsFragment,
087      @Nullable String monthsFragment) {
088    int years = parseIntegerValue(yearsFragment);
089    int months = parseIntegerValue(monthsFragment);
090
091    Period period = Period.of(years, months, 0);
092    return ObjectUtils.notNull(negative
093        // negate for '-' sign
094        ? period.negated()
095        : period);
096  }
097
098  /**
099   * Parses the provided duration value.
100   *
101   * @param value
102   *          the value to parse
103   * @return the parsed duration
104   * @throws IllegalArgumentException
105   *           if the provided value is invalid
106   */
107  @NonNull
108  public static IDurationItem parseDuration(@NonNull String value) {
109    Matcher matcher = DURATION_PATTERN.matcher(value);
110
111    // yearMonth; null is zero months
112    Period period = null;
113    // dayTime; null is zero seconds
114    Duration duration = null;
115
116    if (matcher.matches()) {
117      boolean negative = matcher.group(1) != null;
118
119      Period parsedPeriod = parsePeriod(
120          negative,
121          matcher.group(2),
122          matcher.group(3));
123      if (!Period.ZERO.equals(parsedPeriod)) {
124        period = parsedPeriod;
125      }
126
127      Duration parsedDuration;
128      try {
129        parsedDuration = parseDuration(
130            negative,
131            matcher.group(4),
132            matcher.group(5),
133            matcher.group(6),
134            matcher.group(7));
135      } catch (ArithmeticException ex) {
136        throw new IllegalArgumentException(
137            String.format("Invalid duration value '%s'.", value),
138            ex);
139      }
140
141      if (!Duration.ZERO.equals(parsedDuration)) {
142        duration = parsedDuration;
143      }
144    }
145
146    return validate(value, period, duration);
147  }
148
149  /**
150   * Parse a set of text tokens as a duration value.
151   *
152   * @param negative
153   *          {@code true} if the duration is negative or {@code false} otherwise
154   * @param daysFragment
155   *          an integer value indicating the amount of days in the duration
156   * @param hoursFragment
157   *          an integer value indicating the amount of hours in the duration
158   * @param minutesFragment
159   *          an integer value indicating the amount of minutes in the duration
160   * @param secondsFragment
161   *          a decimal value indicating the amount of fractional seconds in the
162   *          duration
163   * @return a duration based on the calculated seconds and fractional seconds
164   * @throws ArithmeticException
165   *           if the calculated value of seconds in the duration overflow an
166   *           integer value
167   */
168  @NonNull
169  protected static Duration parseDuration(
170      boolean negative,
171      @Nullable String daysFragment,
172      @Nullable String hoursFragment,
173      @Nullable String minutesFragment,
174      @Nullable String secondsFragment) {
175    int days = parseIntegerValue(daysFragment);
176    int hours = parseIntegerValue(hoursFragment);
177    int minutes = parseIntegerValue(minutesFragment);
178
179    BigDecimal bigSeconds = parseDecimalValue(secondsFragment);
180    long totalSeconds = toWholeSeconds(bigSeconds);
181    totalSeconds = Math.addExact(totalSeconds, Math.multiplyExact(days, 86_400));
182    totalSeconds = Math.addExact(totalSeconds, Math.multiplyExact(hours, 3_600));
183    totalSeconds = Math.addExact(totalSeconds, Math.multiplyExact(minutes, 60));
184
185    Duration duration = Duration.ofSeconds(
186        totalSeconds,
187        toFractionalNanoSeconds(bigSeconds));
188    return ObjectUtils.notNull(negative
189        // negate for '-' sign
190        ? duration.negated()
191        : duration);
192  }
193
194  /**
195   * Construct a new Java type adapter for a provided class.
196   *
197   * @param valueClass
198   *          the Java value object type this adapter supports
199   * @param itemClass
200   *          the Java type of the Matepath item this adapter supports
201   * @param castExecutor
202   *          the method to call to cast an item to an item based on this type
203   */
204  protected AbstractDurationAdapter(
205      @NonNull Class<TYPE> valueClass,
206      @NonNull Class<ITEM_TYPE> itemClass,
207      @NonNull AbstractAtomicOrUnionType.ICastExecutor<ITEM_TYPE> castExecutor) {
208    super(valueClass, itemClass, castExecutor);
209  }
210
211  @Override
212  public JsonFormatTypes getJsonRawType() {
213    return JsonFormatTypes.STRING;
214  }
215
216  private static int parseIntegerValue(@Nullable String value) {
217    return value == null ? 0 : Integer.parseInt(value);
218  }
219
220  @NonNull
221  private static BigDecimal parseDecimalValue(@Nullable String value) {
222    return value == null ? ObjectUtils.notNull(BigDecimal.ZERO) : new BigDecimal(value, DecimalAdapter.mathContext());
223  }
224
225  private static long toWholeSeconds(@NonNull BigDecimal bigSeconds) {
226    try {
227      return bigSeconds.toBigInteger().longValueExact();
228    } catch (ArithmeticException ex) {
229      ArithmeticException ex2 = new ArithmeticException(
230          String.format("Whole seconds '%s' is out of range for a long.", bigSeconds.toPlainString()));
231      ex2.addSuppressed(ex);
232      throw ex2;
233    }
234  }
235
236  private static long toFractionalNanoSeconds(@NonNull BigDecimal seconds) {
237    BigDecimal remainder = seconds.remainder(BigDecimal.ONE, DecimalAdapter.mathContext());
238
239    BigDecimal result = remainder.multiply(new BigDecimal("1e9", DecimalAdapter.mathContext()))
240        .setScale(0, RoundingMode.HALF_EVEN);
241    try {
242      return result.longValueExact();
243    } catch (ArithmeticException ex) {
244      ArithmeticException ex2 = new ArithmeticException(
245          String.format("Nano seconds '%s' is out of range for a long.", result.toPlainString()));
246      ex2.addSuppressed(ex);
247      throw ex2;
248    }
249  }
250}
